notes.title: RigRugpdate!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159758/0bbdea8a06efda3fa3e3028e4c4017b390db0f5a.png[/img]
Finally play the oft-mentioned Videlectrix classic RigRug!

Help Handyman Jorge RigRugs in old houses, restoring their original hardwood floors!

If you've completed Roomiside 2 (or if you've figured out the Cheatway to access it and Roomisode X) you can now play the home console version of RigRug at your leisure!

notes.title: More Boring Bug Fixes v1.21
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Addressed more save bugs (conversation progress, visibility of some items not saving), will continue to replicate and repair more as they are found
[*] Added a Cheat to unlock Room X for those who previously completed the whole game but since uninstalled it.
[spoiler]On the main title screen, do the same thing you woulda done in 2005 to [url=http://www.hrwiki.org/wiki/Easter_egg#Finding_Easter_Eggs]locate easter eggs[/url] in a Strong Bad email[/spoiler]
[*] Added some new nonessential dialog, jokes, and clickins to try and make up for bugs.
[*] Looking into Cloud Saves to see if it's feasible
[/list]
Thanks for your continued patience!

notes.title: Boring Bug Fixes v1.2
notes.notes:
Apologies from Videlectrix for launching a buggy Roomisode! Maintenance will continue. Bugs will be eliminated! Graphics will be goodinated!

Seemingly Fixed Bugs:
[list]
[*] Game properly resets after you win (no more Slide Around Town Clown Homestar)
[*] Dead4Dead Achievement should properly be... um, achievable
[*] Added a couple dialog responses where there were none
[*] Fixed bug where Homestar talked like Strong Bad
[*] Added conditional responses to a couple interactions (i.e. use Washer on Dangeresque Too)
[*] Fixed SOME save state issues (still in progress)
[/list]

notes.title: Cocktail Mixin's & Bug Fixin's
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44159758/456daf58ee753c310733d64184c6340c7687caed.png[/img]
v1.01 Update
Some New Li'l Things
[list]
[*]1 new death easter egg
[*]3 new easter eggs (including 1 jingly egg) in bonus section
[*]added watchable game deaths on main menu (upon completion of each roomisode)
[/list]
Bugs Addressed
**NOTE - Some bugs may persist if loading a savegame from the previous build
[list]
[*]Save/Score bug that caused player to no longer gain points after loading a savegame file
[*]Removed redundant sound components from Roomisodes 2 and 3
[*]Room 1: coffee/stamp disappearing on reload
[*]Room 2: meltshake bug that messed up full/empty status of meltshake cup
[*]Room 2: Flippin' sewer cap visibility bug
[*]Room 2: After solving toolbox, the TALK action item option would disappear
[*]Room 2: Streetlight hotspot would disappear when loading an earlier game after smashing streetlight
[*]Room 2: Arcade Guy animation playing incorrectly after loading an earlier game
[*]Room 3: Terminal bug that caused softlock and double Waitre D's if you dragged orders off the screen
[/list]
Thanks for playing and helping us find these bugs. We will keep searching and fixing and improving and probably adding more dumb stuff!

notes.title: There are remasters of the Strong Bad games from 2008 and you can play them now
notes.notes: Back in the early 2000s the flash animations of Homestar Runner duo The Brothers Chaps were some of the best goofs, laughs, and general hilarity you could find on the internet. There were even a few point-and-click adventure games out there to play. Now they're back, and better than ever, as Strong Bad's spinoff Dangeresque adventures come to town... Read more.
